in_hebrew.name: סיסילה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the root 's-s-l', which means 'to put, to place'. Sisile can be interpreted as 'one who puts or places grace, beauty, or eloquence'. This name can also be connected to the Hebrew word 'sisel', which means 'thorn'. However, the connection between Sisile and thorns is not clear.

in_greek.name: Σισιλέ
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the root 'sis-', which means 'to be still, to be quiet'. Sisile can be interpreted as 'one who is still or quiet'. This name can also be connected to the Greek word 'hésis', which means 'a stand, a stay, a pause'. Sisile can be seen as a name that conveys a sense of calmness, stillness, or tranquility.

in_latin.name: Sisilia
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the root 'sis-', which means 'dedication' or 'devotion'. Sisile can be interpreted as 'one who is dedicated or devoted'. This name can also be connected to the Latin word 'sacrare', which means 'to make sacred'.
